legal.termsIntro: Welcome to Art Gallery. By using our website and services, you agree to comply with and be bound by the following terms and conditions of use.
legal.termsSection2Text1: All paintings are original artworks. Auctions last for one hour from the start time. The highest bidder at the end of the auction period wins the right to purchase the painting.
legal.termsSection2Text2: Winning bidders have 24 hours to complete payment through Stripe. If payment is not completed within this period, the painting may be relisted.
legal.termsSection3Text1: All purchases are final. Paintings are sold as-is without warranties. Buyers are responsible for personal collection of purchased paintings from the artist's location.
legal.termsSection3Text2: Shipping is not available. Collection arrangements must be made directly with the artist after payment confirmation.
legal.termsSection4Text1: Payments are processed through Stripe. We accept card payments, BLIK, and Przelewy24. All transactions are secure and encrypted.
legal.termsSection4Text2: Prices are displayed in Polish Złoty (PLN). Currency conversions shown are estimates based on National Bank of Poland exchange rates and are for informational purposes only.
legal.termsSection5Text: Users must authenticate via Google OAuth. You are responsible for maintaining the confidentiality of your account and for all activities that occur under your account.
legal.termsSection6Text: Your privacy is important to us. Please review our Privacy Policy for information about how we collect, use, and protect your personal data.
legal.termsSection7Text: For any questions about these terms, please contact us through the contact information available in your profile after authentication.
legal.privacySection1Intro: We collect information you provide directly to us, including:
legal.privacySection1Item1: Google account information (email, name) when you authenticate
legal.privacySection1Item2: Profile information you choose to provide (phone number)
legal.privacySection2Intro: We use the information we collect to:
legal.privacySection2Item1: Provide, maintain, and improve our services
legal.privacySection2Item2: Process transactions and send you related information
legal.privacySection2Item3: Send you notifications about auctions and orders
legal.privacySection2Item4: Respond to your comments and questions
legal.privacySection2Item5: Monitor and analyze trends, usage, and activities
legal.privacySection3Text: We do not sell your personal information. We may share information with:
legal.privacySection3Item1: Service providers who perform services on our behalf (e.g., Stripe for payments)
legal.privacySection3Item3: When required by law or to protect our rights
legal.privacySection4Text: We implement appropriate technical and organizational measures to protect your personal data against unauthorized access, alteration, disclosure, or destruction.
legal.privacySection5Item3: Request deletion of your account and data
legal.privacySection6Text: We use cookies and similar technologies to improve your experience, analyze usage, and assist in our marketing efforts. You can control cookie settings through your browser.
legal.privacySection7Text: If you have questions about this Privacy Policy, please contact us through the contact information available in your profile.
